canonical_example.text: El sol siempre se agradece tras muchos días de lluvia.
canonical_example.translation: The sun is always welcome after many days of rain.

canonical_example.text: Juan le dio una rosa roja a su novia como símbolo de su amor.
canonical_example.translation: Juan gave a red rose to his girlfriend as a symbol of his love.

canonical_example.text: Creo en un ser superior.
canonical_example.translation: I believe in a supreme being.

canonical_example.text: Creo que podría estar enfermo.
canonical_example.translation: I think he might be sick.

canonical_example.text: No me creo mejor que tú.
canonical_example.translation: I don't believe that I am better than you.

canonical_example.text: ¿Pero tú piensas que se lo cree en serio?
canonical_example.translation: Do you think she really believes that?

canonical_example.text: Nadie me cree.
canonical_example.translation: No one believes me.

canonical_example.text: ¿Te crees tan guapo?
canonical_example.translation: You think you're so good-looking?

synonyms.context: to have confidence; often used with "en"
